body: VEH_HORSE=4 added to protocol.h. HorseState struct with tolt_phase field. horse_spawn_defaults/find_nearby/try_enter/try_exit/tick_all in local_game.h. USE-key mount/dismount in main.c. Collision exclusion for horse rider. Tölt gait: smooth 4-beat, max 8 m/s. Weapon fire disabled while mounted. Lore: Tyler rode Icelandic breed in Toledo 1040-1051 CE per Dawud al-Muthanna manuscript (Valentina archive, S11E06).
title: Add Icelandic horse vehicle (VEH_HORSE=4) — tölt gait, Toledo 1040 CE mount
